property_summary: After any call to withdrawAll() by an account with zero credit, the correct contract never makes an outgoing value transfer and thus address(c).balance is unchanged, whereas the mutant always sends a zero-value call and, crucially, also re-enters through a zero-credit path; the distinguishing rule is that withdrawAll() must not make an external call when the caller's credit is zero, observable by having the caller be a helper whose receive() records every incoming call, so the correct version must record exactly one call per deposit+withdraw cycle while the mutant records an extra zero-value call.
change_summary: Change the guard from `if (oCredit > 0)` to `if (oCredit >= 0)`, allowing the withdrawal path even when the sender has zero credit.
